given: a stock record already exists for a (sku, location) pair
when: a team member files that same (sku, location) pair again and saves
then: they land on the confirmation for that pair, and no error page is shown

independence.rationale: Distinct from AC3's data outcome (no duplicate stored): this AC observes the user-facing outcome that the collision resolves gracefully to a confirmation, which can break (error page shown) even when only one record is stored, and vice versa.
